correctness.rationale: The functorial weight-four reduced Świątkowski model is justified by An–Drummond-Cole–Knudsen. Exhaustive free-chain ranks 495/1980/2700/1440/240 and all boundary-square compositions are checked. Exact unimodular integer cancellations give \(\partial_1\): 494 units, \(\partial_2\): 1481 units and one factor 2, \(\partial_3\): 1199 units, \(\partial_4\): 240 units, proving \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z^4\oplus\mathbb Z/2\), \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^{19}\), \(H_3\cong\mathbb Z\). The 72 chain actions obey generator chain-map identities on all bases. A non-boundary degree-three cycle yields +1 action for all 72 modulo 101, which determines integral ±1 action because H3=Z. The graph cycle summation map gives equivariant rational H1 iso. Direct signed chain Lefschetz traces match a distinct vertex/edge-orbit generating-function formula for all 72. Exact inner products with all nine irreducible characters yield the stated decomposition; the standalone scripts and outputs reproduce all steps.

value.rationale: K3,3 is the canonical smallest complete bipartite nonplanar (Kuratowski) graph, and four particles are the first count at which the 2019 analysis exhibits an exceptional nonproduct third-homology generator. The full automorphism representation distinguishes all nine conjugacy types and tells that the exceptional top class is invariant but neither lower positive-degree space has fixed classes. This gives natural symmetry data for high-degree graph-braid homology, not obtainable from published Betti numbers; no general-family theorem or external certification is asserted.
